name: SubDuctis
description:
About This Game

SubDuctis is a mind-bending puzzle game that explores the concept of space folding. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and reach new areas by utilizing devices called subductors, which collapse space itself.

Master spatial manipulation to traverse a connected world containing over 100 hand-crafted puzzles, surprising mechanics, and secrets to discover.

DEFINE BOUNDARIES

By pushing and relocating subductors, manipulate folded regions to your advantage (or disadvantage).

When activated, pairs of subductors fold away (subduct) all tiles that lie between them, bringing distant objects close, hiding obstacles, and revealing new paths. Likewise, subductors may hide objectives, trigger a deadly explosion, or even fold you out of existence if you're not careful.

FORM CONDUITS

Utilize conductive objects to activate devices from afar.

By folding and unfolding space, conductive paths can be formed and broken.
short_desc: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again.
